name: GST Registration
description: Mandatory registration under the Central Goods and Services Tax Act once turnover crosses the threshold for the state/supply category.
authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) / GST Network

registration_steps.title: Visit the GST Portal
registration_steps.description: Go to www.gst.gov.in and click 'Register Now' under Taxpayers.

registration_steps.title: Complete Part A
registration_steps.description: Enter PAN, mobile number and email; verify both with OTP to receive a Temporary Reference Number (TRN).

registration_steps.title: Complete Part B
registration_steps.description: Log in with the TRN and submit promoter details, principal place of business, and bank account information.

registration_steps.title: Upload documents
registration_steps.description: Attach PAN, address proof, photographs, and authorization forms (board resolution/letter of authorization).

registration_steps.title: Verify and submit
registration_steps.description: Submit using DSC, e-sign, or EVC (OTP). Track status with the ARN issued; GSTIN and certificate typically arrive within 7 working days.

name: Udyam (MSME) Registration
description: Official recognition as a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise under the MSMED Act, required to access MSME schemes, credit guarantees and the 45-day payment protection.
authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

registration_steps.title: Visit the official portal
registration_steps.description: Go directly to udyamregistration.gov.in. Registration is completely free — avoid third-party sites that charge fees.

registration_steps.title: Authenticate Aadhaar
registration_steps.description: Click 'For New Entrepreneurs'. Enter your Aadhaar number and validate it using the OTP sent to your linked mobile.

registration_steps.title: Verify PAN
registration_steps.description: Select your organization type and enter the corresponding PAN to validate it automatically against the income tax database.

registration_steps.title: Enter business details
registration_steps.description: Fill in business name, operating address, bank details, NIC code, and employee count.

registration_steps.title: Submit and generate certificate
registration_steps.description: Complete the self-declaration and submit with a final OTP to receive your Udyam Registration Certificate immediately.

name: Factory License (Factories Act, 1948 / TN Factories Rules, 1950)
description: Registration and license required for any premises where a manufacturing process is carried out with the stated worker counts.
authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH), Tamil Nadu

registration_steps.title: Apply on the TN DISH portal
registration_steps.description: Register on the Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health portal and submit Form 1 for factory registration.

registration_steps.title: Submit site and machinery details
registration_steps.description: Upload the site plan, list of machinery, and details of the occupier/manager.

registration_steps.title: Pay the prescribed fee
registration_steps.description: Fee is calculated based on number of workers and installed horsepower of machinery.

registration_steps.title: Site inspection
registration_steps.description: A Factory Inspector schedules and conducts a physical inspection of the premises.

registration_steps.title: Receive the Factory License
registration_steps.description: On approval, the license (Form 4) is issued, valid till the following December and renewable annually.

name: EPF Registration (Employees' Provident Fund)
description: Mandatory provident fund registration once an establishment reaches 20 employees, applicable across all sectors and states.

registration_steps.title: Visit the EPFO Employer Portal
registration_steps.description: Go to unifiedportal-emp.epfindia.gov.in and register as a new employer using PAN.

registration_steps.title: Verify with OTP
registration_steps.description: A Temporary User ID and password are issued after mobile/email OTP verification.

registration_steps.title: Fill employer details
registration_steps.description: Enter business type, address, bank account, and attach a Digital Signature Certificate (DSC).

registration_steps.title: Upload documents
registration_steps.description: PAN, incorporation certificate, address proof, and a cancelled cheque.

registration_steps.title: Get the PF Code and onboard employees
registration_steps.description: On approval you receive the Establishment Code; then register each employee for a UAN and start monthly ECR filing.

name: ESI Registration (Employees' State Insurance)
description: Health-insurance scheme registration mandatory once an establishment (in a notified ESI area) reaches 10 or more employees, for employees earning up to Rs 21,000/month.

registration_steps.title: Visit the ESIC portal
registration_steps.description: Go to esic.gov.in, click 'Employer Login' then 'Sign Up' to start registration.

registration_steps.title: Fill the Employer Registration Form
registration_steps.description: Form 1 requires company details and employee wage information.

registration_steps.title: Upload documents
registration_steps.description: PAN, address proof, employee list with wages, and bank details.

registration_steps.title: Pay advance contribution
registration_steps.description: Make the initial contribution payment online as computed by the portal.

registration_steps.title: Receive registration number
registration_steps.description: You get a 17-digit registration number; file monthly ESI contributions through the same portal thereafter.

name: Professional Tax Registration
description: State tax on employment/trade; employers in Tamil Nadu must register and deduct professional tax from employee salaries.
authority: Greater Chennai Corporation / respective local body (Commercial Taxes Dept.)

registration_steps.title: Visit the local body / commercial taxes portal
registration_steps.description: e.g. Greater Chennai Corporation's e-services, or your municipality's professional tax portal.

registration_steps.title: Select new registration
registration_steps.description: Choose 'Professional Tax Registration' for employers under the e-services menu.

registration_steps.title: Enter business and salary details
registration_steps.description: Provide employee count and salary slabs to compute the applicable half-yearly tax.

registration_steps.title: Upload proof
registration_steps.description: Business address proof and PAN of the establishment.

registration_steps.title: Pay and download certificate
registration_steps.description: Pay the half-yearly tax online and download the registration certificate for your records.

name: Tamil Nadu Shops and Establishments Act Registration
description: Registration required for commercial establishments (offices, shops, service/trading businesses) not covered under the Factories Act.

registration_steps.title: Visit the TN Labour e-services portal
registration_steps.description: Go to labour.tn.gov.in and select Shops and Establishments Act registration.

registration_steps.title: Enter establishment details
registration_steps.description: Nature of business, address, and number of employees.

registration_steps.title: Upload documents
registration_steps.description: Proof of premises and identity proof of the owner/partners.

registration_steps.title: Pay the registration fee
registration_steps.description: Fee varies by employee count/category of establishment.

registration_steps.title: Download certificate
registration_steps.description: Download the Registration Certificate; renew before its validity period ends.

name: TNPCB Consent to Establish (Water Act)
description: Prior consent from the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board before establishing a manufacturing unit that may discharge trade effluent.

registration_steps.title: Register on OCMMS
registration_steps.description: Create an Industry User ID on TNPCB's Online Consent Management & Monitoring System (ocmms.tn.gov.in).

registration_steps.title: Apply for Consent to Establish
registration_steps.description: Select CTE and declare your industry category (Red/Orange/Green/White) based on pollution potential.

registration_steps.title: Submit project details
registration_steps.description: Upload the project report, site plan, and proposed pollution-control measures.

registration_steps.title: Pay the consent fee
registration_steps.description: Fee is computed by the portal based on project investment and category.

registration_steps.title: Track and receive the Consent Order
registration_steps.description: TNPCB verifies the application (may include a committee review) and issues a digitally signed Consent Order online.

name: TNPCB Consent to Operate (Air Act)
description: Consent required before commencing operations, covering air emissions and effluent discharge from the manufacturing process.

registration_steps.title: Log in to the same OCMMS account
registration_steps.description: Use the Industry User ID created for the Consent to Establish application.

registration_steps.title: Apply for Consent to Operate
registration_steps.description: Submit once construction/installation of pollution-control equipment is complete.

registration_steps.title: Submit effluent/emission details
registration_steps.description: Declare discharge quantities and the control equipment installed on site.

registration_steps.title: Site inspection
registration_steps.description: TNPCB schedules an inspection to verify the installed measures before approval.

registration_steps.title: Receive the CTO
registration_steps.description: The digitally signed Consent to Operate is issued online, renewable periodically (typically 3–5 years).

name: Fire Safety NOC
description: No-Objection Certificate from the Fire and Rescue Services Department, required for factories/establishments above a minimum worker count or built-up area.
authority: Tamil Nadu Fire and Rescue Services Department

registration_steps.title: Visit the TN Fire and Rescue Services portal
registration_steps.description: Apply for a Fire NOC under the relevant occupancy/building category.

registration_steps.title: Submit building plan
registration_steps.description: Upload the approved building plan and details of fire-safety equipment installed.

registration_steps.title: Pay the applicable fee
registration_steps.description: Fee depends on built-up area and occupancy category.

registration_steps.title: Site inspection
registration_steps.description: The department schedules a physical inspection of fire-safety arrangements.

registration_steps.title: Receive the NOC
registration_steps.description: Certificate is issued on satisfactory inspection; renew before expiry.

name: Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act Registration
description: Principal employer registration required where 20 or more workers are (or are likely to be) employed as contract labour.

registration_steps.title: Visit the TN Labour e-services portal
registration_steps.description: Select Principal Employer Registration under the Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act.

registration_steps.title: Declare contractor details
registration_steps.description: Submit the nature and expected duration of work involving contract labour.

registration_steps.title: Upload documents
registration_steps.description: Business proof and details of the contractor(s) engaged.

registration_steps.title: Pay the registration fee
registration_steps.description: Fee is based on the number of contract workers covered.

registration_steps.title: Receive Registration Certificate (Form I)
registration_steps.description: Keep it displayed and renew as required when contractor arrangements change.

name: Payment of Bonus Act Compliance
description: Establishments employing 20 or more persons must pay statutory annual bonus to eligible employees.

registration_steps.title: Maintain bonus records
registration_steps.description: Keep wage and bonus registers as required under the Payment of Bonus Rules.

registration_steps.title: Compute allocable surplus
registration_steps.description: Calculate the allocable surplus for the financial year per the Act's formula.

registration_steps.title: Pay statutory bonus
registration_steps.description: Disburse bonus to eligible employees within 8 months of the financial year end.

registration_steps.title: File the Annual Return
registration_steps.description: Submit Form D to the labour department after payment.

registration_steps.title: Retain records
registration_steps.description: Keep registers available for inspection by labour authorities.

name: Maternity Benefit Act Compliance
description: Applicable to establishments employing 10 or more persons; mandates paid maternity leave and related benefits for women employees.

registration_steps.title: Maintain leave records
registration_steps.description: Track maternity leave in a muster roll/leave register for women employees.

registration_steps.title: Communicate the policy
registration_steps.description: Share the maternity benefit policy in writing during onboarding.

registration_steps.title: Grant statutory leave & facilities
registration_steps.description: Provide 26 weeks of paid leave and a crèche facility if the establishment has 50+ employees.

registration_steps.title: File the Annual Return
registration_steps.description: Submit the return required under the Act to the labour department.

registration_steps.title: Display the Act's abstract
registration_steps.description: Post an abstract of the Maternity Benefit Act at the workplace, as mandated.

name: Internal Committee under the POSH Act
description: Employers with 10 or more employees must constitute an Internal Committee to address workplace sexual-harassment complaints.
authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

registration_steps.title: Constitute the Internal Committee
registration_steps.description: Appoint a Presiding Officer, employee members, and one external member per POSH Act requirements.

registration_steps.title: Draft and circulate a POSH policy
registration_steps.description: Share the policy and complaint procedure with all employees.

registration_steps.title: Conduct awareness sessions
registration_steps.description: Run periodic training so employees know the committee and process.

registration_steps.title: Handle complaints per the Act's timelines
registration_steps.description: Investigate and resolve complaints within the statutory 90-day window.

registration_steps.title: File the Annual Report
registration_steps.description: Submit the Internal Committee's annual report to the District Officer by 31 January.

name: Minimum Wages Act Compliance
description: All employers must pay at least the state-notified minimum wage for the relevant scheduled employment category.

registration_steps.title: Check the current wage notification
registration_steps.description: Look up the minimum wage for your scheduled employment on labour.tn.gov.in.

registration_steps.title: Align your wage structure
registration_steps.description: Ensure pay meets or exceeds the notified rate for each employee category.

registration_steps.title: Maintain wage registers
registration_steps.description: Keep Form X wage registers and issue pay slips.

registration_steps.title: Display the notification
registration_steps.description: Post the current minimum wage notification at the workplace.

registration_steps.title: Track revisions
registration_steps.description: Update pay when the government issues a revised notification (typically every two years).

name: Trade License (Local Body)
description: License from the local municipal body/corporation required to operate any business premises.
authority: Greater Chennai Corporation / respective Municipal Corporation

registration_steps.title: Visit your local body's e-services portal
registration_steps.description: e.g. Greater Chennai Corporation's Online Civic Services for a new Trade License.

registration_steps.title: Enter business details
registration_steps.description: Business category, premises address, and constitution.

registration_steps.title: Upload ownership/rental proof
registration_steps.description: Along with your Udyam certificate if you have one.

registration_steps.title: Pay the license fee
registration_steps.description: Fee depends on business category and premises size.

registration_steps.title: Download the certificate
registration_steps.description: Renew annually before expiry.

name: Legal Metrology (Weights & Measures) Registration
description: Registration required for manufacturing units using weighing/measuring instruments in production or packaging.

registration_steps.title: Contact the TN Legal Metrology Department
registration_steps.description: Via the district office or the department's online portal for manufacturer/dealer registration.

registration_steps.title: List your instruments
registration_steps.description: Submit the weighing/measuring instruments used, with their capacity and accuracy class.

registration_steps.title: Pay the verification fee
registration_steps.description: Fee is based on the number and type of instruments.

registration_steps.title: Instrument stamping
registration_steps.description: An Inspector of Legal Metrology verifies and stamps each instrument.

registration_steps.title: Periodic re-verification
registration_steps.description: Instruments must be re-verified and re-stamped at intervals set by the department.

name: TAN Registration and TDS Compliance
description: Employers must obtain a Tax Deduction Account Number and deduct/deposit TDS on salaries and eligible payments.

registration_steps.title: Apply for TAN
registration_steps.description: Submit Form 49B online via the NSDL/Protean TIN portal or the Income Tax e-filing portal.

registration_steps.title: Receive TAN allotment
registration_steps.description: TAN is issued and can be verified on the e-filing portal.

registration_steps.title: Register on TRACES
registration_steps.description: Set up your TDS account for filing and reconciliation.

registration_steps.title: Deduct TDS
registration_steps.description: Deduct tax at source on salaries and eligible payments per applicable rates.

registration_steps.title: File quarterly returns
registration_steps.description: Submit Form 24Q/26Q each quarter via the e-filing portal.

name: Tamil Nadu Labour Welfare Fund Contribution
description: Employers with 5 or more employees must contribute to the state Labour Welfare Fund on behalf of employees.

registration_steps.title: Visit the TN Labour Welfare Board portal
registration_steps.description: Register your establishment with total employee headcount.

registration_steps.title: Compute the contribution
registration_steps.description: Calculate the combined employer and employee contribution as notified.

registration_steps.title: Pay before the due date
registration_steps.description: Typically payable annually, before 31 January.

registration_steps.title: Use the online challan or portal payment
registration_steps.description: Retain the payment receipt as compliance evidence.

registration_steps.title: Keep records for inspection
registration_steps.description: Maintain contribution records for labour department audits.

name: Employees' Compensation Insurance
description: Employers in manufacturing should maintain compensation insurance cover for workplace injury/death not covered under ESI.
authority: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) / Insurer

registration_steps.title: Approach an IRDAI-licensed insurer
registration_steps.description: Directly or through their online portal for an Employees' Compensation policy quote.

registration_steps.title: Share employee and wage data
registration_steps.description: Headcount, wage bill, and industry risk category determine the premium.

registration_steps.title: Compare coverage
registration_steps.description: Check the policy against the Employees' Compensation Act's schedule of injuries and payouts.

registration_steps.title: Purchase the annual policy
registration_steps.description: Pay the premium and receive the policy document.

registration_steps.title: Renew before expiry
registration_steps.description: Keep the policy active continuously; renew ahead of the expiry date each year.

name: Tamil Nadu Industrial Establishments (National & Festival Holidays) Compliance
description: Employers must grant notified national and festival holidays with wages to all employees.

registration_steps.title: Check the annual holiday notification
registration_steps.description: TN Labour Department publishes the notified national and festival holidays (Form V) each year.

registration_steps.title: Display the list
registration_steps.description: Post it at the workplace before the calendar year begins.

registration_steps.title: Grant paid leave
registration_steps.description: Ensure eligible employees receive paid leave on each notified day.

registration_steps.title: Maintain attendance records
registration_steps.description: Keep records showing compliance for inspection.

registration_steps.title: Track revisions
registration_steps.description: Update the displayed list if the department issues a revised notification.

name: Income Tax Return / PAN Compliance
description: Every registered business must hold a PAN and file annual income tax returns regardless of size.

registration_steps.title: Apply for PAN
registration_steps.description: Via the NSDL/UTIITSL portal, if the business does not already hold one.

registration_steps.title: Maintain books of accounts
registration_steps.description: As required for your business category under the Income Tax Act.

registration_steps.title: Get a tax audit done if applicable
registration_steps.description: Required once turnover crosses the tax-audit threshold for your business type.

registration_steps.title: File the Income Tax Return
registration_steps.description: Submit via the e-filing portal (incometax.gov.in) before the due date.

registration_steps.title: Retain acknowledgements
registration_steps.description: Keep the ITR-V and audit report (if any) for your records.
